what_changed_since_v3.1.5_public_candida: Extensive marathon stabilization work not previously published here: zombie wound-decal geometry leak fix, apartment wall/ceiling gaps, roof-access ladder gameplay verification, cross-building jump-clip exploit seal, throwable warmup fix, rotated-car standing fix, barricade pry-collision desync fix, glass crack visual-reset fix, multiple audio verification passes, corpse-geometry investigation, idle render-stall investigation.

This hardening pass: corrected a wrong 'SE corner' label on the bar roof ladder to the verified 'SW corner' (geometry itself was already correct — label-only fix); confirmed the old exterior fire-escape/catwalk route is fully removed; fixed a real bug where weather (rain/lightning-fog-intensify at wave 7+) defaulted OFF in every single run due to a stale owner-control default, silently overriding the game's own intended on-by-default weather.
known_residuals_disclosed: BAR ROOF LADDER: climbing UP from the second-floor loft to the roof is real-input-proven and works. Climbing DOWN is BROKEN — the player gets stuck near the top rung or falls off the roof edge instead of descending. This is a confirmed, math-backed collision defect (all rungs share one collision footprint, so the physics always resolves to the highest one), not fixed this pass.

WAVE 7 ENCOUNTER: a real boss-tier 'brute' zombie type and a real wave-7+ lightning-flash/fog-intensify storm system both exist in source code, with real combat stats and real charge AI. However, five separate live-runtime attempts this pass did NOT observe a brute actually spawning at wave 7, and did NOT observe the lightning flash actually firing — looked for both, found neither. Not claimed as working.

CANDIDATE BOOT STATUS: this exact build was NOT successfully booted locally by any automated agent before publishing (2 attempts against the local rebuilt file, both inconclusive due to local browser-automation resource contention, not attributed to a game defect). AFTER publishing, one real CDP launch was made against this live public URL and it DID reach a playing state cleanly (title/version banner correct, HP 100, no fatal errors) -- the first successful boot confirmation this exact candidate has had, live, in the real deployed environment.
WEATHER DEFAULT CHANGED: New Game now starts with rain/weather ON by default (previously silently forced off every run). The existing Settings > Weather toggle still lets a player turn it off.

The public v3.0-SLICE1 Arcade entry remains OWNER-REJECTED (~12 FPS, long freeze, ladder/interior issues, weak fog, audio, rooftop, wall complaints from that smoke). This candidate is a newer snapshot, not a fix-confirmed successor to that rejection — most of those original complaint categories were not specifically re-tested this pass.
